scope: High-level planning API first; record low-level model inference separately
rules: Never include API keys, Authorization headers or passwords in reports.
Unknown usage is null, never zero; report usage coverage.
Total=input+output only when provider definitions match; cache/reasoning are subsets, not extra terms.
Cumulative thread snapshots: retain final total or valid deltas, never sum snapshots.
Count logical decisions, HTTP attempts, host tools, chunks and physics steps separately.
Failed/timed-out calls may still cost tokens; retain all attempts and unknown costs.
Do not tokenize image base64 as billed image tokens.
Report warm/cold request timing, queue/network, low-level inference, simulation and initialization separately.
Public video duration and simulated time are not end-to-end wall time.
System2 development/proposals and frozen skill evaluation have separate cost totals.
No cross-model tokenizer ratio can by itself isolate architecture effects.
